display.purpose: The one-per-screen card title (e.g. "iPhone Mania"), Courier Prime, with the ink-title double-strike text-shadow.

label.purpose: Field labels, corner tags, stamp button text, errata lede, footnote copy — anything reading as printed on the ticket.

body.purpose: Helper sentences, informational paragraphs, error message body — Public Sans, never monospace.

shadows.name: ticket-rest
shadows.purpose: The ticket card's only shadow — reads as resting on the carbon backdrop, not floating.

shadows.name: torn-edge-drop
shadows.purpose: Cast by the torn-edge SVG teeth onto the surface below.

shadows.name: corner-tag-lip
shadows.purpose: One-pixel paper-lip shadow under the stapled corner tag.

motion.name: stamp-rotation-settle
motion.purpose: Stamp button straightens slightly while a submit is pending.

components.name: Stamp Button
components.description: Primary submit control styled as a hand-stamped ink mark; the system's signature interaction.
components.css: .ds-stamp-btn { position: relative; width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 10px; cursor: pointer; transform: rotate(-2deg); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-stamp-btn:active { transform: rotate(0.5deg) scale(0.94); } .ds-stamp-ring-outer { position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 2px solid rgba(58,107,82,0.7); border-radius: 255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px; transform: rotate(1.5deg); pointer-events: none; } .ds-stamp-ring-inner { position: absolute; inset: 5px; border: 3px solid #3a6b52; border-radius: 15px 225px 15px 255px / 255px 15px 225px 15px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-stamp-bleed { position: absolute; inset: -4px; opacity: 0.14; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 45% at 38% 65%, #3a6b52 0%, transparent 70%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-stamp-label { position: relative; font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #3a6b52; }

components.name: Ticket Field
components.description: Ruled-line text input with a carbon-copy ghost line, styled as a fill-in line on a work order.
components.css: .ds-ticket-field { display: block; } .ds-ticket-field-label { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: rgb(34 32 28 / 74%); } .ds-ticket-field-wrap { position: relative; display: block; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-ticket-field-input { width: 100%; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #d8d3c4; background: transparent; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #22201c; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-ticket-field-input::placeholder { color: rgb(34 32 28 / 66%); } .ds-ticket-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2c5340; outline-offset: 2px; border-bottom-color: #2c5340; } .ds-ticket-field-echo { position: absolute; left: 4%; right: 8%; bottom: -4px; height: 1px; background: rgb(34 32 28 / 66%); opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Errata Note
components.description: Error/correction callout styled as a stamped errata note; reserved strictly for real error states.
components.html: Errata — Email ou senha incorretos.
components.css: .ds-errata-note { transform: rotate(-1deg); border: 2px dashed #c9463c; background: rgb(201 70 60 / 12%); padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #c9463c; } .ds-errata-lede { font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; }

components.name: Corner Tag
components.description: Stapled-paper status/ID label pinned to a ticket's top-right corner; the system's anti-kicker convention.
components.css: .ds-corner-tag { position: absolute; top: -12px; right: 20px; transform: rotate(3deg); border: 1px dashed #d8d3c4; background: #f2f0ea; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: rgb(34 32 28 / 66%); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #d8d3c4; }

components.name: Ticket Card

narrative.northStar: Ordem de Serviço de Bancada (Repair-Bench Work Order)
narrative.overview:
iPhone Mania is a private two-partner tool, used mid-transaction on a phone in daylight, that wants to feel like the paper work-order ticket a repair bench hands you, not a generic SaaS auth card. Every surface is a single talao (ticket) torn from a carbon-paper pad: a paper card with hand-torn top/bottom edges, pinned under a metal clipboard clip, carrying a stapled-looking corner tag, sitting on a warm carbon-paper backdrop. The world is built from paper, ink, and one sparingly-used stamp of institutional green; it has confirmed no dark mode and no decorative iconography — the only genuinely metallic, non-paper object in the whole world is the clip.

Confirmed visual rejection: no generic rounded-corner SaaS card, no drop-shadow-heavy "modern dashboard" chrome, no blue focus rings or link colors (focus and caret are re-themed to stamp-green so nothing breaks the paper/ink/stamp/errata palette).
keyCharacteristics: Paper-and-carbon material world: torn edges, ruled lines, carbon-fiber cross-hatch texture, a single metal clip
One monospace "ticket voice" (Courier Prime) reserved for titles, labels, and the stamp button; Public Sans carries all reading body copy
A hand-stamped button as the system's signature interactive gesture, deliberately imperfect (rotated, double-ringed, ink-bled)
Errata-red is reserved strictly for error/correction states — never decorative
Corner tags replace kickers/eyebrows: they read as a stapled paper label pinned to the ticket's corner, not as inline text sitting above a title

rules.name: The Errata-Only Rule
rules.body: Errata-red never appears outside an actual error, correction, or destructive-action hint. If a screen has no error, it has no red.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp-green is the only accent color in the system, marking exactly one primary action's identity plus focus/active state.

rules.name: The Ticket-Voice Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is used only for things that are printed on the form (titles, labels, tags, the stamp, footnotes) — never for paragraphs of prose.

rules.name: The Light-Only Rule
rules.body: The system commits to a single light paper mode with no dark-mode variant, because iPhones are evaluated outdoors in daylight during purchase.

rules.name: The Material-Not-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Depth is conveyed by paper materials (torn edges, the metal clip, carbon texture, ruled lines) before it is conveyed by shadow.

dos: Do keep errata-red confined to actual error/correction/destructive states (ErrataNote, sign-out hover) — never as decoration or emphasis.
Do use the torn-edge silhouette (TornEdge) for the top and bottom of any full ticket-style card; don't substitute a rounded corner there.
Do route all focus/caret/selection styling through --stamp/--stamp-dark — never let default browser blue reappear.
Do reserve Courier Prime for "printed on the ticket" elements (titles, labels, tags, the stamp, footnotes) and keep reading prose in Public Sans.
Do treat the corner tag as the system's status/ID marker — a small dashed-border stapled label pinned at the card's top-right corner, not inline text stacked above the title.
Do keep the world light-only; the paper ground is a deliberate outdoor-daylight legibility choice, not an unfinished dark-mode gap.
donts: Don't add drop-shadow-heavy floating-card chrome or hover-lift shadows — depth comes from paper materials, not shadow escalation.
Don't introduce a second accent color alongside stamp-green; the palette's restraint is load-bearing to the "real work order" read.
Don't apply rounded corners to card containers; square corners plus the torn-edge tooth pattern are the system's only silhouette outside the one hand-stamped button.
Don't reuse the stamp button's organic compound-radius/turbulence-filter treatment on other components; it is a one-time signature reserved for the primary submit action.
